built_in_pacing.linkedin: 3–7 seconds only between search pages; detail GETs have no such delay

description_requests.linkedin: One detail GET per job when fetch_description=True
description_requests.indeed: Full descriptions returned by search query; no per-job detail fetch in this scraper
description_requests.glassdoor: Location lookup plus search pages; optional detail queries batch25IDs per HTTP request

failure_surface: Search failures are strings in dataframe.attrs.errors; detail failures may only log warnings and leave description missing; HTTP200 challenge pages need semantic checks. Retry-After headers are not exposed through scrape_jobs return.
production_requirement: Hard per-request budgets require a deliberate versioned transport hook/adapter; outer frequency limits alone cannot enforce them. No runtime-global monkeypatch recommended.
provider_rate_guarantee: No platform-owned numeric read quota was established for public Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby feeds in the official endpoint docs checked. Lever2POST/s is application submission; private authenticatedAPI limits must not be applied to public GET feeds.
